verdict.rationale: Shortcut publishes an llms.txt at www.shortcut.com/llms.txt that links to markdown help pages, such as an .md setup guide for connecting Codex CLI through the Shortcut MCP server, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, probes found no llms.txt (404) and no markdown version (404) on the developer API docs site, and the advertised Swagger/OpenAPI files were not found at the probed paths. Missing for 10: llms.txt or markdown coverage of the developer/API reference, a reachable machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent use of the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: [Codex CLI](https://www.shortcut.com/help/integrations/codex-cli.md): Setup guide for connecting Codex CLI to Shortcut through the Shortcut MCP server.
[Jira Import](https://www.shortcut.com/import/jira/): Direct migration path from Jira, plus Trello import and CSV for other tools.
